news.headline: Wells Fargo Raises uniQure Price Target to $75.00, Keeps Overweight Rating
news.summary: Wells Fargo lifted its price target on uniQure to $75 from $60 while reiterating an Overweight rating, citing early AMT-260 epilepsy data showing substantial seizure reductions and a favorable safety profile as an additional pipeline catalyst alongside AMT-130. The move followed a similar bullish reaction from Wolfe Research, which upgraded QURE to Outperform on July 29 with a $65 target, modeling a 70% probability of success for AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of about $5.8 million and a net loss of roughly $81.1 million (EPS of -$1.22), while cash, equivalents and investments totaled $810.3 million after the June offering, extending its runway into 2030. Management reiterated that the AMT-130 BLA for Huntington's disease remains on track for submission in Q3 2026, alongside a UK MHRA filing.

news.headline: AdCom expected for uniQure's Huntington's gene therapy, chief medical officer says
news.summary: On uniQure's Q2 2026 earnings call, chief medical officer Walid Abi-Saab said the company most likely expects and is preparing for an FDA advisory committee meeting on AMT-130. He noted the company welcomes the scrutiny as it moves toward its planned BLA filing.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Closing of Upsized Public Offering and Full Exercise by Underwriters of Option to Purchase Additional Shares
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized underwritten public offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50 per share, including full exercise of the underwriters' option, for gross proceeds of approximately $259 million. Proceeds are earmarked for AMT-130 commercialization readiness, a potential launch, and a confirmatory study.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Preliminary Data on the First Cohort in the Phase I/IIa Clinical Trial of AMT-260 in Refractory Mesial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
news.summary: In the first, low-dose cohort of six AMT-260 patients, three achieved meaningful reductions in disabling seizures of 79% to 100% from baseline during months four through six of follow-up. No serious treatment-related adverse events were reported as of the data cutoff, and enrollment continues in a higher-dose cohort.

news.headline: uniQure Provides Regulatory Update on AMT-130 for Huntington's Disease
news.summary: Following a Type B meeting, the FDA agreed that roughly 3-year Phase I/II data on AMT-130 can serve as the primary basis for a Biologics License Application seeking accelerated approval, reversing its earlier requirement for a new randomized sham-controlled trial. uniQure said it plans to submit the BLA in Q3 2026, with the high-dose cohort having shown a 75% slowing of disease progression versus external controls, while a confirmatory study using a standard-of-care control arm is still being finalized with the FDA.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission to FDA (plus UK MHRA filing)
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application for AMT-130 gene therapy in Huntington's disease under the accelerated approval pathway, alongside a UK marketing authorization application, after the FDA agreed 3-year Phase I/II data can serve as the primary basis for filing. The design of a required post-approval confirmatory study (likely using a standard-of-care control arm rather than sham surgery) is still being finalized with the FDA.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 topline data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to report four-year follow-up data on all 24 patients from the first two treated cohorts (high- and low-dose) in the Phase I/II Huntington's disease study, using an expanded ~26,000-patient Enroll-HD external control comparator.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA advisory committee meeting for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Management said on the Q2 2026 earnings call it most likely expects and is preparing for an FDA advisory committee (AdCom) review of AMT-130 ahead of a potential approval decision.

catalysts.label: Priority review request for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure intends to request priority review from the FDA at the time of BLA submission, which could shorten the review timeline toward a potential approval and first U.S. commercial launch.

catalysts.label: Updated AMT-260 epilepsy data (higher-dose cohort)
catalysts.detail: Updated Phase I/IIa results are expected from the higher-dose (3x10^12 gc/mL) cohort in the ongoing refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy trial of AMT-260.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and corporate update
catalysts.detail: uniQure's next scheduled quarterly financial results and pipeline update call, following the July 29, 2026 Q2 report; consensus estimates currently place it around early November 2026.

pulse: uniQure remains on a strong regulatory and sentiment upswing following the FDA's June 2026 agreement that roughly 3-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, with filing targeted for Q3 2026 and four-year topline data due in September 2026. A $259 million June offering lifted cash to $810.3 million (runway into 2030), and despite a wider Q2 net loss (~$81.1 million) on minimal HEMGENIX royalty revenue, sell-side sentiment has turned decisively bullish, with Wolfe Research upgrading to Outperform and Wells Fargo raising its target to $75 in late July on top of encouraging early AMT-260 epilepsy data. The stock trades near $44 with a likely FDA advisory committee review still to come before any final approval decision, and the exact design of the required post-approval confirmatory study remains to be finalized with the FDA.
